Photo File Section, UNIT 8 varag'i. Bet raqami yo'q (varaq qirqib olinadi).

⚠ Bu — RASMLI MATN (Photo File 3-unit varag'idagi Paulaning xati bilan bir xil usul): matn ichida SO'Z O'RNIGA RASM qo'yilgan, yonida nuqtali bo'sh joy bor. Jami 17 ta rasm-so'z.

Matn mavzusi: BRITANIYALIKLARNING OVQATLANIShI (nonushta, tushlik, kechki ovqat, yakshanba tushligi).

⚠ Unit 3 varag'idan FARQI: u yerda birinchi javob namuna sifatida berilgan edi, bu yerda HECh QANDAY javob berilmagan.

⚠ KITOB XATOSI: matnda 'traditional English breakfast.This includes' — NUQTADAN KEYIN BO'SH JOY QO'YILMAGAN. To'g'risi: 'breakfast. This includes'.

⚠ Bo'lim boshidan beri unitlar tartibi: 1, 1, 2, 3, 3, 5, 6, 8 — ya'ni UNIT 4 va UNIT 7 uchun varaq YO'Q. Bu kitobning tuzilishi (xato emas).

sections.title: Photo File - Unit 8: Food in Britain

exercises.instructionEn: UNIT 8 - Look at the pictures and write the words.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — RASMLI MATN.

  Matn ichida SO'Z O'RNIGA RASM
  qo'yilgan. Jami 17 ta rasm-so'z.

  Mavzu: BRITANIYALIKLAR NIMA YEYDI.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  NONUShTA:
     1  jam        (murabbo)
     2  cereal     (donli nonushta)
     3  tea        (choy)
     4  bacon      (cho'chqa go'shti tilimi)
     5  eggs       (tuxumlar)
     6  sausages   (kolbasachalar)
     7  tomatoes   (pomidorlar)

  TUShLIK:
     8  salad      (salat)
     9  sandwich   (buterbrod)
    10  pie        (pirog)

  KEChKI OVQAT:
    11  fish       (baliq)
    12  soup       (sho'rva)
    13  vegetables (sabzavotlar)
    14  fruit      (meva)
    15  chips      (kartoshka fri)

  YAKShANBA TUShLIGI:
    16  chicken    (tovuq)
    17  potatoes   (kartoshka)


TO'LIQ MATN (javoblar bilan):

──────────────────────────────────
  People in Britain usually have
  toast with JAM for breakfast, or
  CEREAL with milk. They drink
  instant coffee or TEA with milk.

  Sometimes, they have a traditional
  English breakfast. This includes
  BACON, EGGS, SAUSAGES, TOMATOES
  and some slices of toast.

  Lunch is a quick meal because most
  people are at work. They have a
  one-hour lunch break some time
  between 12 and 2pm. They usually
  have a light meal, such as a
  SALAD, a SANDWICH or a piece of
  PIE.

  Dinner is the main meal of the
  day. Most British people have
  dinner early, between 6 and 8pm.
  A traditional full dinner is FISH
  or SOUP, meat with VEGETABLES,
  and dessert - FRUIT or cheese -
  but nowadays not many British
  people have such a big dinner.

  Sometimes they buy fish and CHIPS
  or Chinese food from take-away
  restaurants instead.

  On Sundays, they usually have a
  traditional Sunday lunch. This is
  roast meat, such as CHICKEN or
  beef, with vegetables and roast
  POTATOES.
──────────────────────────────────


TARJIMASI:

  'Britaniyada odamlar odatda nonushtaga
   murabboli tost yeyishadi yoki sutli
   donli nonushta. Ular eruvchan qahva
   yoki sutli choy ichishadi.

   Ba'zan ular an'anaviy ingliz nonushtasini
   qilishadi. Bunga bekon, tuxum, kolbasacha,
   pomidor va bir necha tilim tost kiradi.

   Tushlik — tez ovqat, chunki ko'pchilik
   ishda bo'ladi. Ularning soat 12 dan 2
   gacha bir soatlik tushlik tanaffusi bor.
   Odatda yengil ovqat: salat, buterbrod
   yoki bir bo'lak pirog.

   Kechki ovqat — kunning asosiy ovqati.
   Ko'pchilik britaniyaliklar erta, soat
   6 dan 8 gacha ovqatlanadi. An'anaviy
   to'liq kechki ovqat — baliq yoki sho'rva,
   sabzavotli go'sht va shirinlik: meva
   yoki pishloq. Lekin hozir ko'p
   britaniyaliklar bunday katta ovqat
   qilmaydi.

   Ba'zan ular buning o'rniga baliq va
   kartoshka fri yoki xitoy taomini
   olib ketish restoranlaridan sotib
   olishadi.

   Yakshanba kunlari odatda an'anaviy
   yakshanba tushligi bo'ladi. Bu —
   qovurilgan go'sht, masalan tovuq yoki
   mol go'shti, sabzavot va qovurilgan
   kartoshka bilan.'


⚠ KITOB XATOSI:

  Matnda yozilgan:
     'breakfast.This includes'

  Nuqtadan keyin BO'Sh JOY qo'yilmagan.
  To'g'risi:
     'breakfast. This includes'


⚠ SANALADIGAN va SANALMAYDIGAN:

  SANALMAYDI (ko'plik yo'q):
     jam, cereal, tea, bacon, soup,
     fruit, chicken, fish, cheese

  SANALADI (ko'plikda yozildi):
     eggS, sausageS, tomatoES,
     vegetableS, chipS, potatoES

  ⚠ NEGA MUHIM:
     'How MUCH jam?'      (sanalmaydi)
     'How MANY eggs?'     (sanaladi)

     'a piece of pie'  — bo'lak bilan
     'a slice of toast' — tilim bilan


⚠ '-OES' KO'PLIK:

     tomato  → tomatOES
     potato  → potatOES

  ⚠ Undoshdan keyingi '-o' ga '-ES'
  qo'shiladi.

  ⚠ LEKIN: photo → photoS, piano → pianoS
  (chet so'zlar oddiy '-s' oladi).


⚠ BRITANIYA va AMERIKA FARQI:

     BrE 'chips'  = qovurilgan kartoshka
                    (yo'g'on)
     AmE 'chips'  = kartoshka chipsi!

     AmE 'French fries' = BrE 'chips'
     BrE 'crisps' = AmE 'chips'

  ⚠ Rasmda YO'G'ON qovurilgan kartoshka —
  demak britancha 'CHIPS'.


⚠ OVQAT NOMLARI ARTIKLSIZ:

     have BREAKFAST   (a/the YO'Q)
     have LUNCH
     have DINNER

  ⚠ LEKIN sifat qo'shilsa artikl keladi:
     'have A traditional English breakfast'
     'have A quick lunch'


⚠ 'TAKE-AWAY' NIMA:

  'a take-away restaurant'
     = olib ketish restorani

  'to take away' = olib ketmoq

  ⚠ AmE: 'take-out' / 'to go'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  jam        = murabbo
  cereal     = donli nonushta
  bacon      = bekon (cho'chqa go'shti tilimi)
  a sausage  = kolbasacha
  a slice    = tilim
  a piece    = bo'lak
  a pie      = pirog
  soup       = sho'rva
  a dessert  = shirinlik
  roast      = qovurilgan (duxovkada)
  beef       = mol go'shti
  a meal     = ovqat, taom
  a lunch break = tushlik tanaffusi
  take-away  = olib ketish (restoran)
  instant coffee = eruvchan qahva
  nowadays   = hozirgi kunda
  instead    = buning o'rniga

items.sentence: 1  People in Britain usually have toast with ......................... for breakfast.  (RASM: murabbo bankasi)
items.uz: Britaniyada odamlar odatda nonushtaga murabboli tost yeyishadi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Rasmda 'Jam' yozuvli banka.

⚠ 'jam' SANALMAYDI — ko'pligi yo'q.
'How MUCH jam?' ('how many' EMAS)

'toast' ham sanalmaydi:
'a SLICE of toast' = bir tilim tost.

items.sentence: 2  ... or ......................... with milk.  (RASM: kosadagi donli nonushta)

commonMistake.whyUz:
Rasmda kosadagi don parchalari.

'cereal' = donli nonushta (kukuruz
parchalari, ovsyanka va h.k.).

⚠ Sanalmaydi.

items.sentence: 3  They drink instant coffee or ......................... with milk.  (RASM: choy solingan piyola)
items.uz: Ular eruvchan qahva yoki sutli choy ichishadi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Rasmda likobcha ustidagi piyolada sutli
ichimlik.

⚠ 'coffee' allaqachon gapda bor — demak
ikkinchisi 'TEA'.

⚠ Britaniyaliklar choyni SUT bilan ichadi.

items.sentence: 4  A traditional English breakfast includes ........................., ...  (RASM: pushti go'sht tilimi)

commonMistake.whyUz:
Rasmda yupqa pushti-oq go'sht tilimi.

'bacon' = cho'chqa go'shtining dudlangan
tilimi.

⚠ Sanalmaydi: 'some bacon'
('a bacon' EMAS).

⚠ KO'PLIKDA! Rasmda bir nechta tuxum.

'an egg' → 'eggS'

⚠ Tuxum SANALADI: 'How MANY eggs?'

⚠ KO'PLIKDA! Rasmda ikkita kolbasacha.

'a sausage' → 'sausageS'

⚠ Ingliz nonushtasi — bekon, tuxum,
kolbasacha, pomidor va tost.

items.sentence: 7  ... sausages, ......................... and some slices of toast.  (RASM: uchta qizil pomidor)
items.uz: ... kolbasacha, pomidor va bir necha tilim tost.

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ KO'PLIK '-OES' bilan!

  tomato → tomatOES  ✓
  tomatos            ✗

Undoshdan keyingi '-o' ga '-ES' qo'shiladi
(potato → potatoes ham shunday).

items.sentence: 8  They usually have a light meal, such as a ........................., ...  (RASM: likobchadagi yashil salat)
items.uz: Ular odatda yengil ovqat yeyishadi: salat, ...

commonMistake.whyUz:
Rasmda ko'k likobchada yashil barglar va
sabzavotlar.

⚠ Gapda 'a' artikli bor — demak BIRLIK:
'a salad'.

items.sentence: 9  ... such as a salad, a ......................... or ...  (RASM: uzun bulochkadagi buterbrod)

commonMistake.whyUz:
Rasmda uzun bulochka ichida go'sht va
sabzavot.

⚠ Ko'pligi 'sandwichES' ('-ch' → '-es'),
lekin bu yerda 'a' bor — BIRLIK.

items.sentence: 10  ... or a piece of ......................... .  (RASM: yumaloq pirog)

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ 'a PIECE OF pie' — bo'lak bilan
o'lchanadi.

⚠ Shu sababli javob BIRLIKDA va artiklsiz:
'a piece of PIE' ('a pie' EMAS).

items.sentence: 11  A traditional full dinner is ......................... or ...  (RASM: butun baliq)
items.uz: An'anaviy to'liq kechki ovqat — baliq yoki ...

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ 'fish' KO'PLIKDA HAM 'fish' —
o'zgarmaydi!

  one fish → two FISH  ✓
  two fishes           ✗

('fishes' faqat turlari haqida gapirganda).

items.sentence: 12  ... is fish or ........................., meat with ...  (RASM: oq kosadagi qizil sho'rva)

commonMistake.whyUz:
Rasmda oq kosada qizil suyuq taom.

⚠ 'soup' SANALMAYDI:
  'some soup', 'a bowl of soup'
  ('a soup' EMAS).

items.sentence: 13  ... meat with ........................., and dessert - ...  (RASM: savatdagi rang-barang sabzavotlar)

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ KO'PLIKDA! Rasmda ko'p xil sabzavot.

'a vegetable' → 'vegetableS'

⚠ Matn oxirida ham 'with vegetables'
yozilgan — bir xil shakl.

items.sentence: 14  ... and dessert - ......................... or cheese.  (RASM: savatdagi banan, olma, uzum)

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ 'fruit' odatda SANALMAYDI —
rasmda ko'p meva bo'lsa ham BIRLIKDA:

  'some fruit'  ✓
  'some fruits' ✗ (faqat turlari haqida)

⚠ 'cheese' ham sanalmaydi.

items.sentence: 15  Sometimes they buy fish and ......................... .  (RASM: sariq qovurilgan kartoshka bo'laklari)
items.uz: Ba'zan ular baliq va kartoshka fri sotib olishadi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ 'FISH AND CHIPS' — Britaniyaning eng
mashhur taomi.

⚠⚠ BrE va AmE ADAShTIRMANG:
  BrE 'chips'  = yo'g'on qovurilgan kartoshka
  AmE 'chips'  = kartoshka ChIPSI!

  AmE 'French fries' = BrE 'chips'
  BrE 'crisps' = AmE 'chips'

Rasmda YO'G'ON kartoshka — britancha 'chips'.

items.sentence: 16  This is roast meat, such as ......................... or beef.  (RASM: qovurilgan butun parranda)
items.uz: Bu — qovurilgan go'sht, masalan tovuq yoki mol go'shti.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Rasmda duxovkada qovurilgan butun parranda.

⚠ 'chicken' IKKI MA'NO:
  'a chicken' (SANALADI) = tovuq (qush)
  'chicken' (SANALMAYDI) = tovuq go'shti

Bu yerda GO'ShT haqida — artiklsiz.

items.sentence: 17  ... with vegetables and roast ......................... .  (RASM: qovurilgan kartoshkalar)

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ KO'PLIK '-OES' bilan!

  potato → potatOES  ✓
  potatos            ✗

⚠ 'roast potatoes' = duxovkada qovurilgan
kartoshka — yakshanba tushligining ajralmas
qismi.

groups.explanationUz: Bu betdagi 17 ta so'z ikkiga bo'linadi.

items.derived: jam, cereal, tea, bacon, soup, fruit, chicken, fish, cheese
eggs, sausages, tomatoes, vegetables, chips, potatoes

groups.explanationUz: Bu betda ikkita shunday so'z bor.

patterns.exampleEn: People in Britain usually have toast with jam for breakfast.
patterns.exampleUz: Britaniyada odamlar odatda nonushtaga murabboli tost yeyishadi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'FOR breakfast' — ovqat mahali oldidan
'for'.
⚠ 'have' = yemoq (bu yerda 'egalik' emas).

patterns.exampleEn: This includes bacon, eggs, sausages, tomatoes and some slices of toast.
patterns.exampleUz: Bunga bekon, tuxum, kolbasacha, pomidor va bir necha tilim tost kiradi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'to include' = o'z ichiga olmoq.
⚠ Ro'yxatda oxirgisidan oldin 'and'.

patterns.formula: ... a light meal, such as a [A], a [B] or [C].
patterns.exampleEn: They usually have a light meal, such as a salad, a sandwich or a piece of pie.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular odatda yengil ovqat yeyishadi: salat, buterbrod yoki bir bo'lak pirog.
patterns.explanationUz:
'such as' = masalan, ... kabi.
⚠ Misol keltirish uchun.

patterns.formula: [Ovqat] is the main meal of the day.
patterns.exampleEn: Dinner is the main meal of the day.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'the main meal' — aniq artikl,
chunki bittagina asosiy ovqat bor.
